name: Restrained native colour adjustment
summary: A small saturation and contrast move using Final Cut's native Color Adjustments effect.
refusalConditions: any request implying a calibrated or perceptual colour target
qualityChecks: the move survives a round trip through Final Cut
failureModes: claiming a magnitude that has never been measured
a change invisible during playback and therefore unverifiable by eye

riskGates.basis: Colour construction exists but its perceptual mapping is unmeasured.

safetyGates.basis: Calibrated targets are outside the admitted evidence.

provenance.claim: Final Cut provides a native Color Adjustments effect
the admitted colour construction is FxPlug:7E2022A5 carrying 18 params and three opaque payloads

conflicts.description: The construction is admitted and round-trips, but no observed mapping connects a creative intensity to the 0-100 Saturation param. The probes reused a captured value of 25.
conflicts.resolution: Card stays reference_only until a mapping is measured. Preview is indicative: direction only, never magnitude.

validation.notes: The construction is admitted; the CONTROL is not. colorEnrichment is unsupported/read-only per docs/PARAMETER_LIVENESS.md, and a colour change at Saturation 25 was invisible during full-motion playback until A/B toggled.

notes: This card is the honest record of a gap: FrameSmith can emit a colour effect it cannot yet steer.
safety: Review the result on representative media before use.
